trust-boundaries.name: Internet to DMZ
trust-boundaries.description: An untrusted customer device crosses into the bank-controlled API perimeter.

trust-boundaries.name: DMZ to core services
trust-boundaries.description: The gateway hands a request to services that hold payment logic.

trust-boundaries.name: Core services to data tier
trust-boundaries.description: The payments service reaches the store that holds card and payment data.

threats.question: spoofing-caller-identity
threats.name: Access token replay
threats.description: An attacker replays a stolen access token to submit payments as the customer.

mitigations.note: Short-lived tokens bound to the device.

threats.question: tampering-in-transit
threats.name: Payment tampering in transit
threats.description: An attacker changes the amount or the payee on the wire between the app and the gateway.

threats.question: denial-of-service-exhaustion
threats.name: Payment endpoint flooding
threats.description: Automated clients flood the payment endpoint and exhaust its capacity.

mitigations.note: Gateway rate limits are not configured yet. The architecture does not declare this control.

threats.question: elevation-of-privilege-authorization
threats.name: Payment from an account the caller does not own
threats.description: A caller changes the payer account identifier and pays from an account they do not own.

mitigations.note: The ownership check covers the payer account only.
Authenticates the gateway, not the end user.

threats.question: information-disclosure-at-rest
threats.name: Card data exposed from storage
threats.description: Card data can be read if database storage or its backups are exposed.

mitigations.note: The database is encrypted. Card numbers still appear in application logs.

threats.question: repudiation-untraced-action
threats.name: Payment cannot be traced to a user
threats.description: A payment record cannot be linked to the user who made it.
threats.justification: Audit logging is planned for the next release. Gateway access logs give partial traceability until then.
